finalText:
All objectives complete. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE:** Ticket `fwrd48-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (reference **RD-1015**, customer "Bench Test Customer", raised 2026-09-12, initial status Draft).

**Objective 2 — DONE:** Part `fwrd48-n1 RD Part A` added with cost 100, markup 25. App-computed price: **$125.00** (row: $100.00 | 25% | qty 1 | Bench Supplies Ltd | $125.00).

**Objective 3 — DONE:** Part `fwrd48-n1 RD Part B` added with cost 200, markup 25. App-computed price: **$250.00** (row: $200.00 | 25% | qty 1 | Bench Supplies Ltd | $250.00). Parts total at that point: $375.00.

**Objective 4 — DONE:** Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup kept at 25). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (row: $150.00 | 25% | qty 1 | Bench Supplies Ltd | $187.50). Parts total became $437.50.

**Objective 5 — DONE:** Ticket RD-1015 ended in status **Ready**. The app accepted "Mark Ready" on the first click for this ticket because its preconditions were already satisfied. I discovered the preconditions via a separate scratch ticket (RD-1016, "fwrd48-n1 RD Scratch Probe", no parts), which the app refused with these verbatim messages:
- Refusal 1: "Ticket is not ready" / "A ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked Ready"
- Refusal 2 (after adding a part with a blank supplier): "Ticket is not ready" / "Part "fwrd48-n1 RD Scratch Part" has no supplier"

So exactly two preconditions are enforced: **(a) the ticket must have at least one part, and (b) every part must have a non-empty Supplier** — notably the part form labels Supplier "Optional", yet Ready is refused while it is blank. RD-1015 satisfied both (two parts, both with supplier "Bench Supplies Ltd"), so no extra work was needed. Status "Ready" persisted across a fresh reload.

**Objective 6 — DONE:** Both parts deleted from RD-1015 (each via row Delete → in-page Confirm modal "Delete part", verified after each removal; final table reads "No parts on this ticket yet." and the Total row disappeared). Ticket then archived — "Archive ticket" was accepted on the first click with no preconditions; the button changed to "Unarchive ticket" and an **"Archived" badge** appears next to Status (verified after reload). I also cleaned up the scratch probe ticket RD-1016 (part deleted, ticket archived) so nothing from this run is left active. On the tickets list with "Show archived" off, a search for "fwrd48-n1" returns "No tickets match the current filters."; with "Show archived" on, only RD-1015 and RD-1016 appear, both flagged Archived with 0 parts.
